title: Technology Sector Update for 05/24/2018: DHX,QUIK
text:

Technology stocks were paring their prior declines Thursday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 losing more than 0.2% while the Philadelphia semiconductor index was posting a more than 0.1% gain.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
- DHI Group ( DHX ) was down more than 1% Thursday afternoon after the technology and data services provider said it sold its Hcareers job board for the hospitality industry to Virgil Holdings, the owner and operator of Virgil Careers, a hiring and recruiting platform using proprietary machine learning and micro-assessments to match job seekers with employers. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
In other sector news:
- QuickLogic ( QUIK ) dropped to a nine-year low on Thursday, losing almost one-third of its value to touch its worst share price since February 2009 at $1.05 apiece after the chipmaker priced a $15.5 million public offering of more than 13.5 million shares of its common stock at $1.15 apiece, or about a 26.3% discount to Wednesday's closing price for the company's stock. Investors in the deal also received a five-year warrant to buy an additional 0.4 of a share for each share they purchased in the stock sale. The warrants have an exercise price of $1.38 a share. Quicklogic expects to use net proceeds from the offering for working capital, developing new products and general corporate purposes.
